purpose: Fictional pending route requests that a traveller's v2 request joins in the 3H demonstration mode (plan 3H/P5, ID-1, I4): four Lyon-Alger round trips on the reference windows, one Lyon-Alger one way and one Marseille-Alger round trip on other routes.
limitations: Requests are fictional; they describe no real traveller.
Budgets lie on both sides of the catalog-v2 list prices, so a coalition is possible but not guaranteed; the expected outcome was not fixed in advance.
Frozen by this manifest before the first planning run (I4-B) and never tuned afterwards; any edit requires updating pool_sha256 here, and the loader refuses a mismatch.
